name: deepseek-code-agent
description: Route coding to Codex-native Luna or persistent DeepSeek/GLM workers, with Codex review.

interface.shortDescription: Route work to native Luna or DeepSeek/GLM with Codex review.
interface.longDescription: Routes bounded work to a Codex-native GPT-5.6 Luna subagent or configurable persistent DeepSeek/GLM workers through OpenCode, with natural-language selection, scoped instructions, corrections, diffs and Codex-owned review and verification.
defaultPrompt: Use Codex-native GPT-5.6 Luna with maximum reasoning for this bounded implementation; do not use OpenCode or external credentials.
Use DeepSeek or GLM to implement this coding goal, then review and verify its patch.
Set OpenCode Go GLM 5.3 Flash with maximum reasoning as my machine default for new coding workers.
Show the current OpenCode worker default and inspect the active coding agent.
